insight.headline: 43 exposed endpoints sit in a Win11 hold that ends 3 days after the Aug 12 deadline
insight.detail: Joining the ServiceNow CMDB export against Jira showed the 43 Austin devices in ITOPS-2860's ring-4 hold (staging Aug 15) can never make ITOPS-2853's Aug 12 patch deadline, and the GitHub pipeline silently skips them. Each tool looks healthy on its own — only the cross-join exposes the guaranteed miss.
insight.action: Approve a ring-4 exception so the 43 Austin devices patch in tonight's #413 window

insight.headline: 57 of the 120 refresh laptops replace devices still exposed to CVE-2026-31842
insight.detail: Mapping the Ariba order lines to ServiceNow's wave-3 retirement list and the CVE exposure export revealed 57 incoming Latitudes replace machines the team is also spending patch effort on under ITOPS-2853. Procurement sees a PO, the CMDB sees vulnerabilities, Jira sees a patch ticket — only the join shows the double work.
